text.tspan: When you’re looking to spice things up, do it with Frank’s RedHot® and
buffalo chicken. Our Buffalo Chicken Footlong is made with everyone’s
favorite hot sauce – Frank’s RedHot® and topped with peppercorn
ranch. Try it with lettuce, tomatoes and cucumbers! Frank’s RedHot® is
a registered trademark of McCormick & Co. and used under license
by Subway Franchisee Advertising Fund Trust Ltd.®/© Subway IP LLC

mozzarella and cheddar cheese. Topped with shredded lettuce, pico de
gallo and avocado. Served with taco sauce on the side.
